metadata.name: CustomerInquiry
metadata.description: The purpose of this API is to display account information to external merchants.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number whose information is required. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Allowable Values: 19

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: MerchantName
children.description: Name of the Merchant where account is opened. Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Format: XXXXXX Example:Merchant 1 Allowable Values: 40

children.name: MerchantID
children.description: Specific ID Assigned to a Merchant. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXX Example:11111111

children.name: ApplicationID
children.description: This tag reflects the Application ID. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:133973

children.name: LastName
children.description: Card holder's last name. Valid Values:A-Z Example:John Allowable Values: 50

children.name: FirstName
children.description: Card holder's first name. Valid Values:A-Z Example:Smith Allowable Values: 50

children.name: ProductName
children.description: Reflects the name of product for the account. Valid Values: a-z Format:xxxxxx Example:Abc revolving Allowable Values: 50

children.name: OpenToBuy
children.description: Remaining Credit Limit which can be used for further posting. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXX.XX Example:200.00

children.name: CreditLimit
children.description: Credit Limit of account. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example:500.00

children.name: ApplicationDate
children.description: Date when the Application was Submitted. Valid Values:0-9 Format:MM/DD/YYYY Example:02/01/2020

children.name: BlockedPosting
children.description: Based on the higher priority status of the account if posting is allowed or not. Valid Values:as per Posting of Transactions field Format:X Example: 0 - No - Posting is allowed 1 - Yes - Posting is not allowed.

children.name: EmailID
children.description: Primary Account Holder Email address. Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Format: [email protected] Example: [email protected] Allowable Values: 100

children.name: MobilePhoneNumber
children.description: Primary Account Holder Mobile phone. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:987567757 Allowable Values: 15

children.name: HomePhoneNumber
children.description: Primary Account Holder Home phone. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7895463214 Allowable Values: 15

children.name: CoApplicantFirstName
children.description: Co- Applicant’s First Name. Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Example:Bob Allowable Values: 50

children.name: CoApplicantLastName
children.description: Co- Applicant’s Last Name. Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Example:Dylan Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AddressLine1
children.description: Debtor Address Line 1. Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Example:123 HWY Allowable Values: 50

children.name: City
children.description: Debtor City. Valid Values:Alphabets, numbers, symbol Format: XXXXXXX Example:Los Angeles Allowable Values: 25

children.name: State
children.description: Address State of the Card Holder. Valid Values: a-z Format: XXX Example:MO Allowable Values: 3

children.name: PostalCode
children.description: Postal code of the applicant’s address. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXX Example:46206 Allowable Values: 9

children.name: ArrayOfAllTransactions
children.description: Array of all purchase and refund transactions including the following transaction fields.

children.name: TransactionDate
children.description: Transaction post date. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 11/01/2021

children.name: CreditPlanNumber
children.description: Plan Number. Valid Values: 0-9,A-Z Format: XXXXX Example: 35216 Allowable Values: 5

children.name: CreditPlanDescription
children.description: Plan description. Valid Values:A-z,0-9 Format:XXX Example:6 Months No Interest if Paid in Full

children.name: TransactionType
children.description: Type of Transaction (purchase, payment etc.) Valid Values: Purchase, Payment Format:XXXXXXX Example:Purchase Allowable Values: 25

children.name: TransactionAmount
children.description: Amount of Transaction Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example:200.00

children.name: TransactionStatus
children.description: Shows status of transaction, if its was a success or  failed Valid Values: success, fail. Format:XXXXXX Example:success Allowable Values: 20

children.name: TransactionID
children.description: Transaction Number for the transaction being posted. Valid Values:0-9 a-z. Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:123372036854802129 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: TransactionDescription
children.description: User defined description of transaction if entered by user explicitly.If not entered by the user, then system will generate it. Valid Values: A-Z,0-9 Format: xxxxxxxx Example:Purchase/Payment. Allowable Values: 100

children.name: APR
children.description: Annual Percentage Rate charged on plan Valid Values: Decimal values Format:XX.XX% Example:15.99%

children.name: RefundFlag
children.description: Flag to display return status Valid Values:  0 = No Refund, 1 = Yes, 2 = Partial refund , 3 = Reversed Format: X Example: 1 = Yes

children.name: PartialRefundAmount
children.description: Amount of Transaction for partial return Valid Values: 0-9 Format:  XXX.XX Example:  200.00

children.name: OriginalPurchaseTransactionID
children.description: Transaction ID of the original purchase. Valid Values: A-Z 0-9 Format: xxxxx Example: 12345678 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: PrintReceiptPromotionText
children.description: The description displayed on Print Receipt against Promotion. Valid Values: A-Z 0-9 Format: xxxxx Example: Text Allowable Values: 1000

children.name: MSRNumber
children.description: MSR Contact number. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXX Example:784565412 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: MSREmail
children.description: MSR's email1. Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXX Example: [email protected] Allowable Values: 100

children.name: MerchantAddressLine1
children.description: Address Line 1 of Merchant. Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Example: 51st Street Allowable Values: 50

children.name: MerchantAddressLine2
children.description: Address Line 2 of Merchant. Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Example: 3rd Block, Main-street Allowable Values: 50

children.name: MerchantCity
children.description: City of Merchant. Valid Values:a-z Format: XXXX Example: Atlanta Allowable Values: 10

children.name: MerchantState
children.description: State of Merchant. Valid Values:a-z Format: XXXXX Example: California Allowable Values: 6

children.name: MerchantPostalCode
children.description: Postal Code for merchant address. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXX Example: 1234 Allowable Values: 10

children.name: StoreID
children.description: Unique Number which is assgined to a Store. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXX Example: 1234

children.name: AccountActivationStatus
children.description: Indicates the account activation status. Valid Values: 1 = Activated, 0 = Not Activated Format: XX Example:0 Allowable Values: 2

children.name: ActivationResponseDateTime
children.description: DateTime of the Activation Response. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: mm/dd/yyyy hh:mm:ss Example: 12/24/2021 11:15:23

children.name: ActivationResponseChannel
children.description: Channel of the Activation response. Valid Values: 1 = Email, 2 = SMS, 3 = CSR Format: xxxx Example: 1 Allowable Values: 10

children.name: EmailIdOfActivationRequest
children.description: Email ID of the customer for Activation Request. Valid Values: 0-9 A-Z Example: [email protected] Allowable Values: 50

children.name: EmailDeliveryStatus
children.description: Status of email delivery. Valid Values: 1 = Delivered, 0 = Undelivered Format: xxx Example: 1 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: EmailDeliveryDateTime
children.description: DateTime of Email Delivery. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: mm/dd/yyyy hh:mm:ss Example: 12/24/2021 11:15:23

children.name: MobileNumberOfActivationRequest
children.description: Mobile number of the Activation Request. Valid Values:  0-9 Format: xxxxxxxxxxx Example: 78984547845 Allowable Values: 11

children.name: SMSDeliveryStatus
children.description: Status of SMS delivery. Valid Values: 1 = Delivered, 0 = Undelivered Format: xxx Example: 1 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: SMSDeliveryDateTime
children.description: DateTime of SMS Delivery. Valid Values:0-9 Format: mm/dd/yyyy hh:mm:ss Example: 12/24/2021 11:15:23

children.name: ValidEmailAddress
children.description: Flag for valid email address. Valid Values:True / False Example: True

children.name: ValidMobilePhone
children.description: Flag for valid Mobile Phone. Valid Values:True / False Example: True

children.name: MobilePhoneLineType
children.description: Type of Mobile Phone Line. Valid Values:Mobile / Landline Example: Mobile

children.name: ActivationMTAConsolidationFlag
children.description: Indicates whether account activation and MTA Consolidation process is enabled for the merchant or not. Valid Values:1 = Yes , 0 = No Example: 0

children.name: ArrayOfAllAuthorizations
children.description: Array of all authorizations on account including the following authorization fields.

children.name: AuthTranTime
children.description: Auth transaction date and time. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 10:10:01

children.name: AuthorizationStatus
children.description: Must return Authorization Status. Valid Values: Outstanding = If Transaction Authorization is Outstanding ,Rejected = If Transaction Authorization is Rejected,Expired = If Transaction Authorization is Aged-Off,Decline = If Manual Auth from CC is Declined,Matched = If the Transaction Authorization is Accepted Example:Outstanding

children.name: TransactionAmount
children.description: Amount of Transaction of the Auth. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example:200.00

children.name: RejectReason
children.description: Must display the Reject reason only for transaction  type ‘Cleared’ Rejected’ and must be updated with the latest Response. Valid Values: Did Not Authorize, Services Not Yet Scheduled, Services Scheduled Beyond 30 Days, Wrong Amount, and Wrong Plan or Cancelled by Provider Example:Wrong Plan Allowable Values: 100

children.name: TransactionID
children.description: Transaction Number for the transaction being posted. Valid Values: 0-9, a-z Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:23654789 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: CreditPlanDescription
children.description: Plan description corresponding to the Auth. Valid Values: A-z,0-9 Format: XXX Example: 6 Months No Interest if Paid in Full

children.name: ADCResponse
children.description: This value corresponds to the response code provided in the return authorization. Valid Values: 03 = Invalid Card Number, 07 = Trancode Mapping Not Found ,10 = Duplicate Transmission Detected ,09 = Invalid Transaction Amount ,72 = Insufficient Funds,05 = Do Not Honor,01 = Refer To Card Issuer,49 = Account Status Is Overlimit,50 = Account Status Is Auto Close,52 = Account Status Is Fraud,53 = Account Status Is Stolen,54 = Account Status Is Lost Card,55 = Account Status Is Blocked,56 = Account Status Is Closed,57 = Account Status Is Initial Charge-off,58 = Account Status Is Closed By Customer,05 = Do Not Honor,107 = Auths to B-Bankruptcy Account; Decline,80 = Exceeds Daily Purchase Limit,48 = Account Status Is Delinquent Format: XX Example: 54

children.name: AuthorizationResponseDateTime
children.description: DateTime of the Authorization Response. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: mm/dd/yyyy hh:mm:ss Example: 12/24/2021 11:15:23

children.name: AuthorizationChannel
children.description: Channel of the Authorization response. Valid Values: 1 = Email, 2 = SMS, 3 = CSR Format: xxxx Example: 1 Allowable Values: 10

children.name: EmailIdOfAuthorizationRequest
children.description: Email ID of the customer for Authorization Request. Valid Values: 0-9 A-Z Format: [email protected] Example: [email protected] Allowable Values: 50

children.name: EmailDeliveryStatus
children.description: Status of email delivery. Valid Values: 1 = Delivered, 0 = Undelivered Format: xxx Example: 1 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: EmailDeliveryDateTime
children.description: DateTime of Email Delivery. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: mm/dd/yyyy hh:mm:ss Example: 12/24/2021 11:15:23

children.name: MobileNumberOfAuthorizationRequest
children.description: Mobile number of the Authorization Request. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxxxxxxxxxx Example: 78984547845 Allowable Values: 11

children.name: SMSDeliveryStatus
children.description: Status of SMS delivery. Valid Values: 0-9 A-Z Format: xxx Example: 1 = Delivered, 0 = Undelivered Allowable Values: 20

children.name: SMSDeliveryDateTime
children.description: DateTime of SMS Delivery. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: mm/dd/yyyy hh:mm:ss Example: 12/24/2021 11:15:23

children.name: ValidEmailAddress
children.description: Flag for valid email address. Valid Values: True / False Example: True

children.name: ValidMobilePhone
children.description: Flag for valid Mobile Phone. Valid Values: True / False Example: True

children.name: MobilePhoneLineType
children.description: Type of Mobile Phone Line. Valid Values: Mobile / Landline Example: Mobile

children.name: PendingActivationAuth
children.description: PendingActivationAuth.

children.name: DateTimeOfPendingActivationAuth
children.description: Indicates the DateTime of submission of the Pending Activation Auth. Valid Values:0-9 Format: mm/dd/yyyy hh:mm:ss Example: 12/12/2021 11:12:13

children.name: PendingActivationAuthStatus
children.description: Indicates the status of pending activation auth. Valid Values: Outstanding,Expired , Converted Cancelled Format: Example: 0 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: PendingActivationAuthID
children.description: Pending activation Auth transaction number. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx Example: 23654789 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: TransactionAmount
children.description: Transaction Amount. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xx Example: 50 Allowable Values: 10

children.name: PlanDescription
children.description: Description of the plan. Valid Values: a-z 0-9 Format: abcd Example: 12 Month Regular Revolving Allowable Values: 50
